import json, os, pathlib, subprocess

root = pathlib.Path('/run/media/tutrinh/NewData/dreamy-codex-toolkit')
out = pathlib.Path('/tmp/dreamy-audit-20261029')
fake = out / 'fake-unity.py'
fake.write_text('''#!/usr/bin/env python3
import pathlib, sys
args = sys.argv
pathlib.Path(args[args.index('-logFile') + 1]).write_text('Fixture runner completed\\n')
pathlib.Path(args[args.index('-testResults') + 1]).write_text('<test-run result="Skipped" total="0" passed="0" failed="0" skipped="0" />')
''')
fake.chmod(0o755)
env = dict(os.environ, DREAMY_UNITY_PATH=str(fake))
result = subprocess.run(['node', str(root / 'harness/dreamy-harness'), 'test-editmode', str(root / 'tests/fixtures/unity/vertical-slice')], env=env, text=True, capture_output=True)
report = {'kind': 'synthetic-adapter-probe', 'realUnityExecuted': False, 'inputXml': '<test-run result="Skipped" total="0" passed="0" failed="0" skipped="0" />', 'processExitCode': result.returncode, 'stdout': result.stdout, 'stderr': result.stderr}
(out / 'empty-test-probe.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2))
print(json.dumps(report))
